summary: Executed backend API regression (products + newsletter) and partial frontend e2e on production preview URL. Backend passed fully. Frontend core catalog/search/modal/WhatsApp pricing checks mostly passed, but extended bag/footer flows were blocked by intermittent modal open behavior in repeated automation runs.

ui_bugs.issue: Intermittent failure: clicking [data-testid='product-open-VEL-RN-101'] did not consistently open [data-testid='product-modal'] in repeated automation runs (flaky open behavior).

action_items: Fix flaky product modal opening from product cards (likely interaction/overlay/race condition with motion state).
After modal-open stability fix, retest remaining bag workflows (variant merge/split, qty limits, persistence, checkout WhatsApp payload) and full responsive pass on 390/360/320 + 768.
Re-run frontend full regression including deep-link #product-VEL-RN-101, footer dialogs, and newsletter feedback after UI stabilization.
critical_code_review_comments: App state/orchestration in frontend/src/App.js is highly condensed into large inline expressions, reducing maintainability/debuggability for UI race issues.
Product modal interaction reliability appears susceptible to transient UI timing/interaction layering; add deterministic open-state checks and interaction guards.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Newsletter test used unique runtime emails.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression is green (6/6). Frontend verified pass points: desktop load, nav/category/filter reset, load-more to 20, image load check (20/20 visible), search by SKU opens modal, ring default size 7, metal price math (+18% platinum alt, +4% rose alt), gallery full/detail toggle, nested size guide open/close, product WhatsApp href content. Blocker: repeated intermittent modal-open failure during extended scripted flows after reload/state reset. Test credentials file exists but is empty (no auth flows applicable).
rca of the issue: Reproduction: on repeated automation runs, clicking product card open button sometimes does not transition to visible ProductDialog within timeout though selector exists and is visible. Likely UI race/interception related to animated card layers/hover controls/scroll state and modal trigger timing rather than backend/API failure. Mitigation: instrument click target overlap/z-index, add deterministic wait for interactive-ready state before click, and consider explicit pointer-events isolation on card controls.
